column5: notes
IEEE-754 double max, 1.7976931348623157e308; the game's ~1.79e308 cap (Infinity score / IP / Eternity IP)
Prestige is unlocked when the score reaches 1e10 (10B).
Promotion becomes available for the first time when P.Mult exceeds x1000 (either on-hand or upcoming P.Mult).
Unlocked at 1 million score.
Upon reaching 1.79e308 Score, an option to Infinite for Infinity Points (IP) will be displayed.
Upon having ~1.79e308 IP (2^1024 IP), an option to Eternate for Eternity Points (EP) will be displayed.
Unity is the 3rd major prestige layer in the game. It is reached when you have 1.08e2466 EP.
Upon reaching e3,080 score, the 10x IP bar will fill up. Every e308 increase in score will 10x the IP gain for your current run.
Have 32 Σ : "Breaks Eternity" (IP is no longer limited to ~1.79e308 IP [2^1024 IP])
Generator Mult is softcapped at 1e1,000.
After your first singularity, you will need 1.8e308 Atoms to perform a Singularity again.
And hardcaps at 10^{10^{256}} score cost.
There are 10 Circles in total.
Each circle can be upgraded to a maximum of 100+(amount of ascensions x10) levels before needing to be ascended.
The maximum level of each buyable increases by 10 per ascension.
Ascending resets a circle to level 5, multiplies its Mult Gain by the Ascension Power, and raises its level cap by 10.
Cost multiplier of each circle is increased by +0.1 each time it ascends.
Ascension power is 10x by default, but can be improved later on with future upgrades.
To begin with GP is powered to 0.666, but this can be improved with Infinity Upgrades (14;2, 19;1 and 20;2).
As of update V1.068, there are a total of 70 unique relics, each unlocking at specific Attack levels.
After reaching 301 levels of any relic, it can be sacrificed.
There are 81 different Animals and a total of 1,524 AP is required to buy them all.
a total of 1,524 AP is required to buy them all.
The Soul Shop is unlocked after reaching 5 minutes of unscaled playtime.
The total cost to buy all boosts and skins is 1,930,000 Souls (not including Zodiac Slots, Macro Slots and Macro Blocks)
